t: A LoRa radio board with GPS and a big battery holder for off-grid messages.
steps: Buy the T-Beam from the LilyGO store or Tindie. Pick the radio band for your country.
Buy one flat-top 18650 cell without a protection board.
Screw on the LoRa antenna before you power it up.
Choose the pre-flashed Meshtastic version for the easiest start.
Install the Meshtastic app on your phone and pair over Bluetooth.
Send a test message to a friend with a second node.
To write your own code, install the Arduino IDE and pick ESP32 Dev Module with PSRAM turned on.
Open the LoRa example from the LilyGO LoRa Series repo and set the radio type in utilities.h.
meta: Open Board. From $30.65. A few stores.
